title: TransportChannelLimits
description: Exact common packet and inbound-buffer bounds for one channel.

x-agp.mechanics: Defines the bounded transport-channel-limits value crossing the neutral transport boundary.
x-agp.rationale: One schema and generated type prevent adapter-specific reinterpretation.
x-agp.consequence: A divergent shape makes transport implementations observably incompatible.

maxPacketBytes.description: Maximum bytes in one decoded packet.

maxBufferedBytes.description: Maximum aggregate inbound packet bytes retained.
